summary:
Revised implementation plan including Android APK & Capgo OTA updates:
1. Database Schema Lock: Lock live PostgreSQL schema from DDL migrations
2. One-Click VPS Installer: `scripts/install-vps-one-click.sh` for online backend & API
3. One-Click Raspberry Pi Installer: `install-pi.sh` with Tailscale integration & offline-first local POS setup
4. Android APK & Capgo OTA: Update OTA bundle script (`make-ota.js`), Capacitor Android config, Sunmi T2 SDK hardware bridge, and fallback server URL targeting Pi local IP -> VPS Tailscale IP
5. Comprehensive Operational Guide: `PANDUAN-DEPLOY-VPS-DAN-PI-TAILSCALE.md`
6. System Health & Tailscale UI: Dual-node real-time status & OTA version monitoring in POS UI
